compiled_state.author: Joe Oakhart
compiled_state.description:
ADP is a general-purpose platform. A target repository it is piloted against must not appear in its committed configuration.

`compose.override.yaml` is tracked and names a client repository four times. Line 78 mounts `../archive-massgov-pfml:/repos/archive-massgov-pfml` into `activity-worker`, line 113 mounts it read-only into the repository-intelligence services, and lines 91 and 116 register it in `REPO_INTELLIGENCE_REPOS`. Line 76 carries a comment naming the client product. These sit beside the platform's own `agentic-demo-*` mounts, which belong there.

`config/local/checks.yaml` is tracked while every other operator-edited config in that directory is not. `.gitignore` lines 8-26 establish the convention that the platform ships a `.yaml.example` template and ignores the operator's `.yaml`, applied to `github`, `jira`, `integrations`, `gates`, `gate_engine`, `tickets`, and `review-trust-root`. `checks.yaml` ships a `checks.yaml.example` but has no ignore pair, so it was committed. The operator's copy carries a client entry and is held back only by a `skip-worktree` bit, which also hides local edits from `git status`.

Project compose overlays have no ignore rule. The pilot overlay is excluded through `.git/info/exclude`, which lives outside the repository and protects one checkout. A fresh clone has no such protection.

`README.md:132` and `tests/unit/test_intake_base.py:64` carry `base:joeoakhart/PFMLPB-33758`, which is a personal account name and a client ticket key.

Client repository names also appear as sample values in nine test fixtures. Those encode no client behaviour and are out of scope here.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] No tracked file under version control names the client repository, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_repo_hygiene.py -k no_tracked_file_names_a_client_repository`
- [ ] No tracked file under version control carries a personal home directory path or account name, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_repo_hygiene.py -k no_tracked_file_carries_a_personal_account_path`
- [ ] Every operator-edited config in the config directory has an ignore rule paired with a shipped example, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_repo_hygiene.py -k every_operator_config_is_ignored_and_has_an_example`
- [ ] Project compose overlays are ignored while the platform's own compose files stay tracked, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_repo_hygiene.py -k project_compose_overlays_are_ignored`
- [ ] The documented base branch example uses a neutral account and ticket, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_intake_base.py -k declared_base_preserves_the_supplied_branch`

## Testing
Run each acceptance criterion selector on its own. Run `PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" .venv/bin/inv ci` before closing the ticket.
compiled_state.title: Remove client-specific configuration and personal paths from tracked platform files
